Whether `\` separates path segments, which depends on the target: on
Windows it does, as `/` does; on Linux, macOS and WebAssembly it is an
ordinary byte of a file name.

## Functions

### backslash_separates

```khora
pub fn backslash_separates() -> Bool
```

Whether `\` separates path segments on this target: `true` on Windows,
`false` everywhere else. Where it does not, `granted\evil` is a directory
beside `granted` and not inside it.
